POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Vehicle body, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body.

2. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

4. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

5. When learning Blending of lines and curves, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending of lines and curves.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Blending of lines and curves.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending of lines and curves.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.

6. When learning General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

7. When learning Evolution of motor vehicles, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution of motor vehicles.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Evolution of motor vehicles.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

9. When learning Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.

10. When learning Vehicle body joining processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body joining processes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body joining processes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body joining processes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body joining processes.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

12. When learning Road wheels, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Evolution of motor vehicles and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Power Mechanics workshop layout and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain General workshop rules and regulations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.

2. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

3. B — CPU

4. C — Information and Communication Technology

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution of motor vehicles.

8. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body joining processes.

11. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

12. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Evolution of motor vehicles; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Power Mechanics workshop layout; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of General workshop rules and regulations; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
